name: SIFY Chandigarh
notes: DC Hub lists SIFY Chandigarh in Chandigarh, IN as operational with 3.0 MW reported power. Baxtel describes Sify building the Chandigarh facility in phases with Phase I operational in October 2025; third-party/aggregate evidence, not confirmed from an official Sify facility page.

name: CenterServ Chandigarh Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists a CenterServ Chandigarh Data Center at Godrej Eternia, Industrial Area Phase I, Chandigarh. Capacity was not disclosed in public search-accessible listing.

name: NIC Chandigarh Data Centre / Mini Cloud Centre
developer: National Informatics Centre, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
notes: NIC Chandigarh infrastructure page says Mini Cloud setups are operational in state units including Chandigarh; directory has a Chandigarh Data Centre staff section and was last updated 2026-07-28. Government ICT facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: Punjab Engineering College Computer Centre Data Centre
notes: PEC says a Data Centre has been established in the Computer Centre for the Central Research Lab under TEQIP II, supporting virtual labs and server virtualization. Institutional facility; capacity not disclosed.
